description: An additive layer of higher-false-positive tells, opted into alongside the base set as extends: ["deslopper:recommended", "deslopper:aggressive"]. Every tell is warn tier: the preset trades precision for reach, and the user triages. No tell here shares a (name, phase) with a recommended tell, so layering never replaces one in place. Words like vector, primitive, surface, harness, and scaffolding are excluded on purpose: a regex cannot tell the metaphor from the legitimate technical term.

tells.name: abstract-metaphor
tells.message: abstract metaphor, pick the concrete word

tells.name: cutoff-disclaimer
tells.message: cutoff disclaimer, find the fact or cut

tells.name: formulaic-challenge
tells.message: formulaic challenge framing, give the specific fact

tells.name: generic-conclusion
words: at the end of the day
tells.message: generic conclusion, state a plan or fact

tells.name: boldface-overuse
tells.message: three or more bold spans on one line, bold at most one thing

tells.name: strong-intensifier
tells.message: strong intensifier, cut it or give the evidence

tells.name: unicode-arrow
tells.message: arrow in prose, write the step or the cause in words

tells.name: missing-piece
tells.message: claim of a gap others missed, show the gap and what fills it

tells.name: contrarian-hook
tells.message: contrarian hook against an unnamed crowd, state your claim and its evidence

tells.name: overreach
tells.message: absolute claim with no support, back it with evidence or soften it

tells.name: invented-concept-label
tells.message: coined label used as an established term, describe the effect instead

tells.name: tutorial-signposting
tells.pattern: \blet['’]?s (?:(?:dive|delve) in(?:to)?|break (?:this|it) down|unpack|explore)\b|\bin this (?:article|post|guide|section|tutorial),? (?:we'?ll|we will|I'?ll|I will)\b|\bby the end of this (?:article|post|guide|tutorial)\b|\bto recap\b
tells.message: tutorial signpost, start with the first step

tells.name: contrast-adverb
tells.pattern: \b(?:rather than|(?<!\bdo )(?<!\bdoes )(?<!\bdid )(?<!\bcan )(?<!\bshould )(?<!\bmust )(?<!\bwill )(?<!\bwould )(?<!\bcould )not|isn'?t|is not) (?:merely|simply|solely)\b|\bless like an? [^.,;]{1,40} and more like\b|\bis genuinely\b
tells.message: contrast with a softening adverb, say what it is

tells.name: strawman-tail
tells.pattern: , not (?:the other way(?: around| round)?|the (?:reverse|inverse|opposite)(?!\s+[a-z])|vice versa)\b|, not (?:one|once) (?:per|for each|for every)\b
tells.message: negated tail nobody claimed, cut it and keep the claim

tells.name: restatement-marker
tells.message: restatement marker, say it once and plainly

tells.name: numbered-lead-in
tells.message: count announced before a list, start the list

tells.name: claude-figurative
tells.message: figurative word, use the literal one
